lines: Your Planning application runs your budget.
But who runs your Planning application?
The admin who built it moved on.
Close week comes, a rule fails, and the fix waits in a queue with strangers.
Bryant Park Consulting Managed Services is a team that already knows your build.
From the consultants who implemented your environment.
Requests go to your own Slack channel.
A named team picks them up by severity, and your whole team sees everything.
You reserve a monthly block of hours.
Unused hours roll over, and your balance is posted every week, so nobody has to ask.
You also get the Customer Hub: your environment documented, product guides, and an AI that answers from them.
